description.from: Agreed 2026-10-05 feature-engineering evaluation plan. Depends on core feature-bank/single-feature API tracked by Decision-Flywheel issue 1baadb68-9f35-432c-a900-8e2d9f8e7d44. Before live collection freeze a text-free protocol: training/development/audit roles, feedback cutoff, per-class counts, frozen incumbent rubric and examples, provider/model, question versions, weighting, fitting procedure, primary development metric and explicit request/trial ceilings. Start by comparing one additional question at a time against the same incumbent; later run budgeted pairs/groups and removal ablations. Report training probability separation as descriptive evidence, not generalization. Measure incremental development improvement, coverage, redundancy and interactions; retain unsuccessful concepts and wording variants for later feedback cutoffs. Distinguish feature exploration from classifier deployment; a losing bundled classifier does not invalidate each factor. Keep optimizer blind to development/audit labels and errors. Do not tune or choose experiments using sealed scoreboard results. Publish counts, trial ledger, usage, uncertainty and retrospective limitations without private article text, feedback comments or secrets. First milestone is a reproducible single-feature experiment using the reusable core, not a second flywheel implementation. No live calls authorized by creating this issue. No DSPy.
description.to: Replacement protocol after sample-size review: evaluate independently scheduled example selection, rubric refinement and question measurement; do not combine them as one winner-selection cycle. New question measurement freezes active rubric/example list/existing questions and retrospectively backfills complete augmented requests over eligible reviewed items, default configurable cap200. Freeze window/cutoff/selection policy, feedback roles and revisions, context versions, question definitions, model and request budgets. Rank candidates on a matched window using human final labels, not merely model main-answer agreement; supporting answers are model features, not their own human ground truth. Direct agreement requires matching semantics; otherwise class-conditional probabilities and out-of-fold learned final-label mapping with inverse/multiclass relationships. Show actual N/per-class counts, majority baseline, natural and balanced alignment, coverage/uncertainty; distinguish training association from cross-validated rank and fresh holdout accuracy. Preserve protected audit/scoreboard roles and target-label/comment exclusion. Retrospective ranks do not automatically promote a classifier. Old four-item comparisons are execution evidence/hypotheses, not credible improvement claims. Retain feature/revision history and rerun as feedback/context grows. Core issue 1baadb68 owns reusable stage/backfill/ranking mechanisms; this repository freezes protocols and reports results. Combination/ablation experiments follow the new staged feature matrix. No DSPy, no second flywheel implementation, no paid calls merely from recording the plan.
